verdict.rationale: Versioned APIs with a deprecation policy are a fair question for a backend-as-a-service like Appwrite, so the axis applies. The evidence only shows that Appwrite offers REST and GraphQL APIs and keeps a changelog. Nothing documents API versioning or a deprecation policy, so the verdict is none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
